chunks: There is no obedience to a created being in disobedience to the Creator.

key_terms.مَخْلُوقٍ: a created being, such as a human or other creature
key_terms.مَعْصِيَةِ: disobedience, sinful violation of Allah’s command

ai.seo_question: When must a Muslim refuse to obey another person?
ai.summary: This hadith establishes a foundational principle: no human authority may be obeyed when that obedience entails disobedience to Allah. It underscores the absolute priority of the Creator’s command over all created beings and serves as an ethical and legal guide in matters of authority and duty.
